title: 65 Lorcan Crescent, Santry, Dublin 9, D09YD50
description:
Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to bring to the market this substantial three-bedroom semi-detached family home, ideally situated in a mature and established residential setting in Santry. Extending over three floors, this impressive property has been thoughtfully extended to provide generous and versatile accommodation, with a side extension, extended kitchen and dedicated home office.

One of the property's most notable features is its large, private south-facing rear garden, which enjoys excellent natural light and incorporates a unique private spa area with sauna and hot tub, together with a beautiful octagonal sunroom. The property also benefits from ample off-street parking to the front.

On entering the property, the welcoming hallway leads to a generous front-to-back living room with feature stone fireplace and wood burning stove. The central dining area flows through to the impressive extended kitchen, which features extensive oak cabinetry, tiled flooring, skylight and ample space. 
The ground floor also provides a home office, shower room with plunge pool, W.C making the accommodation particularly practical for modern family living.

Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including an impressive primary bedroom, a further double bedroom with fitted wardrobes and a single bedroom. A modern family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

The attic level provides a large and versatile room, complete with skylight and eaves storage. This space offers excellent flexibility and could be utilised as an additional bedroom, home office or a studio.

Accommodation:

Foyer - 1.93m (6'4") x 3.87m (12'8")
Welcoming front entrance with timber wall panelling and carpeted stairs.

Office - 3.56m (11'8") x 3.15m (10'4")
Front-facing workspace with extensive built-in cabinetry, desk area and wood-effect flooring, ideal as home office or study.

Kitchen/Diner - 2.93m (9'7") x 6.42m (21'1")
Generous galley-style kitchen with modern fitted units, tiled floor, skylight, and space for dining table; appliances include oven, hob, fridge freezer, dishwasher and washing machine.

Sauna - 1.51m (4'11") x 1.86m (6'1")
Timber-clad sauna room with built-in bench seating, adjoining the spa-style bath area, perfect for relaxation.

Spa Room (Rear Ground) - 2.8m (9'2") x 4.42m (14'6")
Spacious room with Sauna and Jacuzzi.

Bath (Central Ground) - 2.29m (7'6") x 1.84m (6'0")
Fully tiled shower room with WC, wash-hand basin and plunge pool.

Hall (Inner Ground) - 2.29m (7'6") x 1.63m (5'4")
Inner corridor linking the foyer to the main reception and ground floor shower room, with timber panelling and red carpet.

Living Room - 3.75m (12'4") x 7.55m (24'9")
Expansive dual-aspect living room with feature stone fireplace and an elegant wood burning stove, ceiling coving with access to the sunroom.

Sun Room - 2.87m (9'5") x 7.72m (25'4")
Large octagonal sun room / conservatory overlooking the long rear garden, flooded with natural light.

Hall (First Floor) - 2.01m (6'7") x 2.48m (8'2")
Bright landing with timber wall panelling and window to the side, giving access to bedrooms, bathroom and stairs to the attic room.

Bath (First Floor) - 2.07m (6'9") x 1.78m (5'10")
Main family bathroom with tiled walls and floor, shower enclosure, WC and pedestal wash-hand basin, finished in neutral tones.

Bedroom - 3.64m (11'11") x 3.31m (10'10")
Double bedroom with fitted wardrobes, large window and carpeted flooring, overlooking the rear of the property.

Bedroom - 2.52m (8'3") x 3.02m (9'11")
Single bedroom  with built-in storage, carpeted floor.

Primary Bedroom - 3.64m (11'11") x 4.08m (13'5")
Spacious principal bedroom with extensive fitted wardrobes, large window and neutral décor.

Attic Room - 5.05m (16'7") x 2.88m (9'5")
Versatile attic space reached by fixed staircase, offering a generous additional room with rooflight, ideal as playroom, hobby room or storage.

Total Floor area: 179.95 m² / 1937 ft² approx.

Externally: The front of the property features a spacious gated driveway. This area provides ample room for secure off-road parking. To the rear, there is a large south facing rear garden that offers significant outdoor space.

Viewings are strictly by appointment only via the local agents Smith & Butler Estates on 018665600.
